key_decisions: THE PLUGIN DECLARES A MODEL, NOT ITS WEIGHTS - requiredModels ['ltx-23-balanced'], requiredDeps []. Listing the six LTX weights was tried and REVERTED: _pluginRequiredDepIds protects a plugin's deps unconditionally, so it pinned the five shared support weights and MPI-258 B1 failed. DO NOT re-propose the obvious cure either - 'protect only while every dep is present' IS the fullyInstalled gate MPI-310 proved destroys weights. Both circularities are in docs/download-manager.md; NO GC GUARD WAS TOUCHED.

EVERY UI ELEMENT IN THE APP IS A COMPONENT - Fabio, 2026-08-20, stated as law. If nothing covers the use, a NEW COMPONENT IS CREATED. FLOWS ARE NO EXCEPTION: a Flow can carry all sorts of components, but they are all components. The add-flow docs currently say the opposite (commit 55461326: 'declared controls, so a Flow needs no JS component') and that framing is why agents keep putting foreign controls into Flows. Fixing the words is MPI-582.

MpiProgressBar IS the app's slider - its own header: 'Absorbs all MpiSlider capabilities - this is the single source of truth for sliders'. There is no MpiSlider Primitive and there does not need to be.

NO CSS FILE WAS TOUCHED by the slider fix and none needed to be: .mpi-progress__input is appearance:none + transparent, so the leftover accent-color declarations are inert, and the mount host keeps the block's field-range class so existing flex sizing still applies. That also kept the edit clear of MpiBaseFlow.css, which the peer session had claimed.

BOTH SLIDER RANGES ARE MPI-568'S AND CLOSED BY FABIO - denoise UI 0-1 over start sigma 0.50-0.85 default 0.5; prompt strength UI 0-1 over cfg 1-3 default 0. cfg defaults to the no-guidance end ON PURPOSE; a plan recommendation of 3 was overruled. The positive prompt MUST default empty.
